arguments.message: Hi there! If you see a duplicate charge, our billing team needs to review it before any refund can be issued. Duplicate charges aren’t automatically reversed from the dashboard because we have to verify the payment processor’s records against our own. Please open a billing dispute (or have the account owner or an authorized billing contact do so) and our team will investigate the charge.
